text: The cat curled up on the windowsill.
A sparrow pecked at the bread crumbs.
The cod was caught in the North Sea.
An iguana sunbathed on the warm stone.
A beetle crawled across the path.
A bat flew out of the cave at dusk.
The flamingo stood on one leg.
A clownfish hid in the anemone.
The lizard caught a fly with its tongue.
A dragonfly hovered over the pond.
The dolphin jumped beside the ship.
A woodpecker drilled into the tree.
The pike waited among the reeds.
A ladybird walked along the leaf.
The giraffe ate leaves from the treetop.
A crow sat on the fence.
The carp swam to the surface of the pond.
